$comment: Manual overrides for the printed-overlay depth bias. Read by 'pnpm pipeline overlays'.
The DETECTOR is geometric and is not name-based, on purpose - see overlay-depth.ts.
This file is the escape hatch for a garment a HUMAN has looked at and disagrees with,
so a material name is the right key here: a person has to be able to read it.
garment  - the .glb basename, without the extension. Empty matches any garment.
material - the material name, matched exactly.
force    - 'bias' to flag it anyway, 'skip' to leave it alone.
factor   - optional. MUST be between -8 and -64; anything else is REFUSED, because
the viewer would silently ignore it and the file would claim a repair
note     - why. Required. It ends up in the asset as the reason.
An entry that matches no material in the file is REPORTED as stale, never ignored.
